def transform(g):
    import collections
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    sep_cols=[c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and g[r][c]!=bg]
    redges=[-1]+sep_rows+[h]
    cedges=[-1]+sep_cols+[w]
    panels=[(redges[i]+1,redges[i+1],cedges[j]+1,cedges[j+1])
            for i in range(len(redges)-1) for j in range(len(cedges)-1)
            if redges[i]+1<redges[i+1] and cedges[j]+1<cedges[j+1]]
    src=None
    for (r0,r1,c0,c1) in panels:
        vals={g[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)}
        if vals-{bg}: src=(r0,r1,c0,c1)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if src:
        r0,r1,c0,c1=src
        block=[row[c0:c1] for row in g[r0:r1]]
        for (a0,a1,b0,b1) in panels:
            if (a0,a1,b0,b1)==src: continue
            for i in range(a1-a0):
                for j in range(b1-b0):
                    out[a0+i][b0+j]=block[i][j]
    return out
